=== BEGIN docs/ARCHITECTURE.md ===
   1| ## 2. Media storage
   2| 
   3| Fernhill Photos keeps every uploaded photo and its thumbnail in one object store. This section
   4| describes the four components that use that store and the relations between them.
   5| 
   6| ### 2.1 Components
   7| 
   8| | Component | Technology | Owner | Responsibility |
   9| | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
  10| | Upload API | Go service | Gallery team | stores each uploaded photo as an original |
  11| | Media bucket | object storage | Platform team | holds originals and thumbnails, one prefix each |
  12| | Thumbnail service | Python worker | Gallery team | produces one thumbnail per original |
  13| | CDN | managed edge cache | Platform team | serves thumbnails at the network edge |
  14| 
  15| ### 2.2 Relations
  16| 
  17| - The Upload API writes originals to the Media bucket.
  18| - The Thumbnail service reads originals from the Media bucket.
  19| - The Thumbnail service writes thumbnails to the Media bucket.
  20| - The CDN reads thumbnails from the Media bucket.
  21| 
  22| No other component reads or writes the Media bucket.
  23| 
  24| ### 2.3 Access rules
  25| 
  26| Each component signs its requests with its own service identity. The Upload API may write only
  27| under the originals prefix. The Thumbnail service may read the originals prefix and may write only
  28| under the thumbnails prefix. The CDN may read only the thumbnails prefix. The Platform team grants
  29| these permissions and reviews them whenever a component changes owner.
  30| 
  31| ### 2.4 Out of scope
  32| 
  33| Image moderation, the storage classes of the Media bucket and the cache rules of the CDN are
  34| described in §5.
=== END docs/ARCHITECTURE.md ===
